    out_w_ptr,                 # *ptr to [M, K] float32
    out_i_ptr,                 # *ptr to [M, K] int32
    E: tl.constexpr,           # number of cols (experts)
    K: tl.constexpr,           # top-k
    stride_r: tl.constexpr,    # row stride in elements for router
    stride_wo: tl.constexpr,   # row stride in elements for out_w
    stride_io: tl.constexpr,   # row stride in elements for out_i
    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,       # block size (>= E, power-of-two)
):
    m = tl.program_id(0)
    row_r = router_ptr + m * stride_r

    # Top-K buffers (registers / vectors)
    topv = tl.full((K,), -float("inf"), dtype=tl.float32)
    topi = tl.full((K,), -1, dtype=tl.int32)

    # Pass 1: scan columns, update topv/topi elementwise
    for j in range(0, BLOCK):
        mask_j = j < E
        v = tl.load(row_r + j, mask=mask_j, other=-float("inf")).to(tl.float32)

        # t = 0: allow equality to get argmax; t > 0: strict better to cap to K
        better0 = v >= topv[0]
        topv = tl.where(better0 & mask_j, v, topv)
        topi = tl.where(better0 & mask_j, j, topi)

        for t in range(1, K):
            better = v > topv[t]
            topv = tl.where(better & mask_j, v, topv)
            topi = tl.where(better & mask_j, j, topi)
        # end t-loop

    # Pass 2: softmax over top-K (numerically stable)
    maxv = topv[0]
    for t in range(1, K):
        maxv = tl.maximum(maxv, topv[t])
    numer = tl.exp(topv - maxv)
    sumv = tl.sum(numer, axis=0)
    weights = numer / sumv

    # Store results (contiguous K slots per row)
    row_w = out_w_ptr + m * stride_wo
    row_i = out_i_ptr + m * stride_io
    for t in range(0, K):
        tl.store(row_w + t, weights[t])
        tl.store(row_i + t, topi[t])
